files.projects/sync/README.md:
# Ledger sync

Synthetic Rust tool with maintained scripts.
files.projects/sync/scripts/release.sh:
# Checks, tags and publishes the crate.
cargo test
git tag "v$1"
cargo publish
files.projects/sync/scripts/dev-setup.sh:
# Installs a developer's toolchain.
rustup component add clippy rustfmt
files.projects/sync/ci/run-tests.sh:
# Runs the test suites in CI.
cargo test --all-targets

Give the tests, the benchmark and the scripts finer categories, so that the category table tells apart unit tests, tests that run the built binary, shared test helpers, benchmarks, and each of the three kinds of script. grading: Recovered mistakes may pass; record recovery cost. Required conclusions missing => incomplete. Wrong delivered figures, a changed built-in purpose, merged categories the task asks to tell apart, or unclaimed source => critical failure.
